// @molis-ai/molis-work-plugin-sdk/diff-view: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface DiffFileEntry {
    path: string;
    kind: "added" | "modified" | "deleted";
    added_lines: number;
    removed_lines: number;
}

export type DiffMode = "unified" | "split";

export type DiffPhase = "waiting" | "unavailable" | "ready";

export interface DiffSide {
    workspace_id: string;
    workspace_name: string;
    path: string;
    source_plugin_id: string;
    content_version: number;
}

export interface DiffSides {
    before: DiffSide;
    after: DiffSide;
}

export interface DiffTextChange {
    before: string;
    after: string;
    created?: boolean;
    removed?: boolean;
}

export interface DiffView<Group extends string = string> {
    phase: DiffPhase;
    mode: DiffMode;
    group: Group | null;
    message: string;
    recovery?: string;
    coarse: boolean;
    identical: boolean;
    metadata_changes?: readonly string[];
    empty: boolean;
    created: boolean;
    removed: boolean;
    mismatch: boolean;
    partial: boolean;
    before?: DiffSide;
    after?: DiffSide;
    rows: readonly TextDiffRow[];
    files: readonly DiffFileEntry[];
}

export interface DiffViewLabels {
    readonly before?: string;
    readonly after?: string;
    readonly pinned?: string;
    readonly mismatch: string;
    readonly partial: string;
    readonly coarse: string;
    readonly created: string;
    readonly removed: string;
    readonly identical: string;
    readonly comment_before: string;
    readonly comment_after: string;
    readonly insert: string;
    readonly delete: string;
    readonly same: string;
    readonly reveal: string;
}

export type DiffViewMessages = Readonly<Record<string, {
    readonly zh: string;
    readonly en: string;
}>>;

export interface DiffViewModel<Group extends string = string> {
    readonly view: DiffView<Group>;
    readonly primitives: DiffViewPrimitives;
    readonly labels: DiffViewLabels;
    readonly line_feedback?: boolean;
    readonly fold_context?: number;
    readonly sides?: boolean;
}

export interface DiffViewPrimitives {
    escape(value: unknown): string;
    text: DiffViewText;
    icon(name: string): string;
}

export type DiffViewText = (value: string, values?: Record<string, string | number>) => string;

export interface UnifiedHunk {
    before_start: number;
    before_count: number;
    after_start: number;
    after_count: number;
    section: string;
    rows: readonly TextDiffRow[];
}

export interface UnifiedPatchFile {
    path: string;
    created?: boolean;
    removed?: boolean;
}

export declare function compareChange<Group extends string>(group: Group | null, sides: DiffSides, change: DiffTextChange): DiffView<Group>;

export declare function compareHunks<Group extends string>(group: Group | null, sides: DiffSides, diff: string, change?: {
    created?: boolean;
    removed?: boolean;
}): DiffView<Group>;

export declare function countChangedLines(hunks: readonly UnifiedHunk[]): {
    added: number;
    removed: number;
};

export declare function diffViewText(messages: DiffViewMessages, locale?: ActionLocale, templates?: readonly string[], say?: DiffViewText): DiffViewText;

export declare function emptyDiffView<Group extends string>(group: Group | null, message: string, phase?: DiffPhase, recovery?: string): DiffView<Group>;

export declare function hunkRows(hunks: readonly UnifiedHunk[]): TextDiffRow[];

export declare function parseUnifiedDiff(diff: string): UnifiedHunk[];

export declare function renderDiff(model: DiffViewModel): string;

export declare const unifiedErrors: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly no_hunks: "invalid";
    readonly bad_header: "invalid";
    readonly count_mismatch: "invalid";
}>;

export declare function unifiedPatch(rows: readonly TextDiffRow[], file: UnifiedPatchFile): string;
